sentences.en: A student should not lose sight of his own identity.
sentences.zh: 学生不应该忽视自己的身份。

sentences.en: The police could not establish the identity of the man.
sentences.zh: 警方无法确认那名男子的身份。

sentences.en: Our language is an important part of our cultural identity.
sentences.zh: 我们的语言是我们文化身份的重要组成部分。
